title: Diamond in the Rough
start: Speak to Osman in Al Kharid palace.

recommended.t: Desert heat protection (four full waterskins are given)

rewards.l: Constitution XP lamp (Diamond in the Rough)

rewards.t: 250 Combat XP lamp in one of the following skills: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic , scl | Necromancy or scl | Prayer
rewards.l: Combat XP lamp (Diamond in the Rough)

rewards.t: 1 sapphire, 1 emerald, 1 ruby (if picked up from dung kalphites)
Access to the Kalphite nursery, where you can obtain Aten (Heru's shield)(override) and Uraeus (Apep's axe)(override) from slicing dung kalphites

steps.t: Talk to Osman in Al Kharid palace without a follower or pet. [Chat: Accept]
p: Having a little chat with Osman

steps.t: Talk to Ozan just outside the palace, north of your current location.
After the cutscene, inspect the Het scales to receive the heavy weight.
Climb the rope to end up on the roof (the vault has a teleblock active).
Home Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone.
Head south-east to the Shantay Pass.
Go through the Shantay Pass. [Chat: 4 Let's keep going.]

sub.t: Do not interrupt the cutscene, or you will have to go back to the palace to retrieve Ozan.

steps.t: Inspect the sundial (Het).
Click the "Menaphite script | D "" symbol on the outer ring to align the sundial to the symbol of Het (human face). Continue dialogue with Ozan.
Head south-west to the sundial (Apmeken). Inspect it. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: It is possible for the scene to be interrupted and nothing happens afterwards. In this case, just inspect it again.

steps.t: After the cutscene, kill the bandits and their king.
Pick up the sundial gnomon dropped by the last bandit killed. Ozan will take it if the backpack is full.
p: A figure emerges from the sand...

steps.t: Inspect the sundial to fix it.
Click the "Menaphite script | W " symbol on the left bottom corner of the outer ring to align the sundial to the symbol of Apmeken (monkey head). Continue dialogue with Ozan.
Head north-west for a cutscene, north of the fairy ring. [Chat: Any › Any › Any › Any]
After the cutscene, keep entering any of the tunnels. Ozan will eventually mention he is sitting on something uncomfortable.
Inspect the sundial (Crondis).
Click the "Menaphite script | L " symbol on the right bottom corner of the outer ring to align it to Crondis (crocodile head).
Enter the tunnel the sunbeam points to and walk through the tunnel at the end of the path.
Slice open the dung kalphites until the Kharid-ib is found.

sub.t: A bronze scimitar can be found on the ground near the torch for players without a slashing weapon.
The sparkling kalphites contain gems and must be slashed open. They appear to have an extra glowing circle near their heads.
You must slice open any three kalphites before they will begin to sparkle.
Changing various game settings can help identify the sparkling ones.
Switch your graphics settings' "Lighting Detail" option to "Low".
Switch your audio settings' "Ambient Sounds" option on. A twinkle sound indicates the sparkling one is nearby.

p: Why did it have to be dung kalphites?

steps.t: For the last kalphite, pick up the kharid-ib and a cutscene ensues.
Climb-out the exit (the rope that appears in the centre).
Talk to Ozan or Leela.
Inspect the sundial (Scabaras).
Click the "Menaphite script | P " symbol on the outer ring to align it to Scabaras (beetle).
Head south-west and talk to Lady Keli. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Yes.]
Kill Apep and Heru.

sub.t: Epilepsy warning: There is a full screen flash effect during the fight.

steps.t: Talk to Prince Ali Mirza.
Continue dialogue with Osman and Leela.
Quest complete!
